poison_tests: Nonconsecutive XNYS sessions cannot satisfy intraday clock-grid continuity.
Future features, labels, calibration rows, and fold-training rows fail closed.
Entry, timeout, target, stop, and benchmark fills require observed one-minute evidence.
Same-minute target and stop ambiguity resolves stop-first and adverse stop gaps fill at the worse executable price.
Costs are applied exactly once and cannot fall below 10 basis points round trip.
Raw opportunity score drives ranking; calibrated downside probability is only a veto.
Walk-forward folds are purged and embargoed; unseen-ticker validation is a separate acceptance scope.
Sparse setup decisions are assigned actual clock phases before nonoverlap is asserted.
Catalyst history without immutable first-observed lineage remains data_blocked.
Dataset shards, requests, manifests, policy hashes, implementation hashes, and authority pointers fail closed on drift.
Collection, dataset construction, and training enforce the 3.25 GiB safety threshold and 4 GiB hard limit.
review_findings_closed: Corrected daily continuity to use consecutive XNYS session ordinals rather than adjacent observed ticker dates.
Made deterministic opportunity and downside formulas explicit and content-addressed.
Made missing deterministic downside inputs contribute conservative maximum risk instead of nonfinite values.
Separated raw opportunity ranking from calibrated downside veto.
Proved actual-time nonoverlap before assigning unit overlap weights.
Kept catalyst outside the estimator and blocked overlay evaluation without causal event availability lineage.
Corrected CLI completion handling to use the authoritative bundle status.
